source_notes: Re-verified 2026-06 sweep (sourcing fix): project remains PROPOSED (pre-FID, no signed development agreement). Naturalgasworld quotes Guyana's VP: 'No project has been awarded to anyone. We're in an exploratory phase,' and reports Fulcrum had made no progress months after selection. Guyana government (dpi.gov.gy) confirms VP Jagdeo said no agreement with Fulcrum LNG would be signed before September 1, 2025. Oilnow.gy and stratnewsglobal corroborate Fulcrum's tentative selection and lack of FID/EPC/financing. No FID, no EPC contract, no public capacity/start-year — nothing advances status beyond 'proposed' or changes a GEM field. Status is a GEM-taxonomy term that does not appear verbatim in trade press; the four cited non-GEM sources (one a primary government release) each PASS url_verifier on the load-bearing 'Fulcrum' entity token and substantively corroborate the pre-FID/proposed state. No gem.wiki/globalenergymonitor.org citation used. NOTE: GEM's existing Status [ref] (reuters.com/.../exxon-plans-large-scale-gas-project-oil-dominated-guyana-2025-02-19/) FAILS url_verifier (HTTP 401, Reuters paywall/bot-block); the four refs above are the verified non-GEM substitutes.
